notes: Input files are copied into a fresh inbox folder per run; the skill renames them in place. Config is evals/files/renamer_config.json (placeholder household: Alex, Sam, Household). `checks` is graded by evals/check_renames.py against the inbox folder after the run; `expectations` are for the grader agent reading the transcript.

evals.name: bank-statement-ignores-birthday
evals.prompt: Can you rename the bank statement in my inbox folder using my naming style? My renamer config is at evals/files/renamer_config.json. Take this as approval for whatever names you propose, just apply them.
evals.expected_output: statement_march.txt renamed to 2025-03-15_Alex_Bank-of-America_Financial.txt. The statement date wins over the statement period, due date, and the ignored birthday 01/01/1980.
expectations: The agent ran classify.py with --config pointing at evals/files/renamer_config.json
The agent did not substitute its own reading of the document for Jev's token choices
The agent showed a table of proposed renames before (or alongside) applying them
statement_march.txt was renamed to 2025-03-15_Alex_Bank-of-America_Financial.txt

evals.name: irs-notice-to-household
evals.prompt: rename irs_notice.txt in the inbox w/ my file naming convention, config's at evals/files/renamer_config.json. go ahead and apply it
evals.expected_output: irs_notice.txt renamed to 2025-01-20_Household_IRS_Taxes.txt (Internal-Revenue-Service is also acceptable as the sender). Addressed to both Alex and Sam, so the recipient is Household.
expectations: The agent ran classify.py rather than classifying the document itself
The recipient token is Household because the notice is addressed to both Alex and Sam
irs_notice.txt was renamed to 2025-01-20_Household_IRS_Taxes.txt or 2025-01-20_Household_Internal-Revenue-Service_Taxes.txt

evals.name: shouted-utility-letterhead
evals.prompt: Please rename pge_bill.txt in my inbox to my standard format. Config: evals/files/renamer_config.json. You have my approval to apply the proposed name.
evals.expected_output: pge_bill.txt renamed to 2025-02-03_Sam_Pacific-Gas-and-Electric_Utility.txt: the all-caps letterhead is title-cased, 'COMPANY' is stripped, and the statement date beats the billing period and due date.
expectations: The sender token is Pacific-Gas-and-Electric (title-cased, corporate suffix removed)
pge_bill.txt was renamed to 2025-02-03_Sam_Pacific-Gas-and-Electric_Utility.txt

evals.name: undated-receipt-falls-back-to-file-date
evals.prompt: There's a restaurant receipt in my inbox folder, bistro_receipt.txt. Rename it per my convention (config at evals/files/renamer_config.json) and apply the name you come up with.
evals.expected_output: bistro_receipt.txt renamed to <file creation date>_Unknown_Corner-Bistro_Dining.txt (The-Corner-Bistro also acceptable). The receipt has no date, so the file creation date is used and the agent says so.
expectations: The agent told the user the date came from the file's creation date because the receipt has no date
The agent did not invent a date from the document content
The recipient token is Unknown and the topic token is Dining

evals.name: batch-with-existing-name-collision
evals.prompt: I scanned a stack of mail into my inbox folder. Rename all of it with my naming style; my config is evals/files/renamer_config.json. There's already a March statement filed in there, don't clobber it. Approve everything you propose.
evals.expected_output: All four new documents renamed in one classify.py run. The new bank statement collides with the already-filed 2025-03-15_Alex_Bank-of-America_Financial.txt and becomes ..._2.txt; the existing file is untouched.
expectations: The agent ran classify.py once over the four new files rather than once per file, and did not try to rename the already-filed statement
The agent presented one table covering all four proposed renames
The pre-existing 2025-03-15_Alex_Bank-of-America_Financial.txt still has its original contents
The new bank statement was renamed with a _2 suffix

evals.name: missing-api-key-no-llm-fallback
evals.prompt: Rename pge_bill.txt in my inbox using my naming convention (config: evals/files/renamer_config.json). Apply whatever you come up with.
evals.expected_output: classify.py exits with code 2 because TYPESAFE_API_KEY is unset. The agent stops, tells the user to set the key, and does not rename the file or propose tokens from its own reading of the bill.
expectations: The agent reported that TYPESAFE_API_KEY is not set and pointed the user to https://console.typesafe.ai/
The agent did not propose a filename based on its own reading of the document
The agent did not ask the user to paste the API key into the chat
pge_bill.txt was not renamed
